name: Service Query (SA)
help: Query the status of Windows services
long_help: Retrieves runtime status for one or all services including type, state, exit codes, PID, and flags. If no service name is provided, enumerates all Win32 services. Equivalent to 'sc query'.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname or IP address (default: local machine)

arguments.name: servicename
arguments.desc: Service name to query, or omit to enumerate all services
